name: Amane Natsuki
source:
"You're so... close, Onii-chan... I feel so nice... and cozy."

Natsuki is very introverted, and as a result, struggles to communicate and socialize with others. It's her first year in high school, and her classmates are a bit overprotective of her.

Being as soft-spoken as she is, it's no wonder that when she wants to convey a thought, she'll do it through actions instead of words, which may come across as a little childlike. She'll sometimes fail at expressing herself, but there's no cuter sight. She reminds you of an adorable, small animal. She's very quiet and docile by nature, always honest and never has any hidden intentions, which makes it very easy to read what's on her mind.

[url=/c77659]Takeru[/url] once saved her, so now as a result, she clings to him. Whenever she's with Takeru, or trying to get his attention, she always has the most precious smile imaginable on her face. You just can't help but want to make her happy seeing that.

[From [url=http://meltymoment.nekonyansoft.com/]English official site[/url]]
